note: The primary Line Space Workshop and its book passage now proceed by count: two, three, four, more. The first three stations keep count and rod lengths fixed. The associated bounded geometry experiment checks 29 arrangements; headset reach and comfort remain unverified. Older line studies remain available.

stops.title: Connect two points
stops.action: Bring the two points together. Watch the line appear and the barrier fly apart.
stops.question: What did connecting two positions allow you to do?

stops.title: Give a span a measure
stops.action: Move the measuring line's endpoints. Compare the changing distance with one metre.
stops.question: What does a unit let us compare?

stops.title: Cross a red line
stops.action: Approach the red line, then cross it and look back.
stops.question: What does this division change, and what do we bring to it?

stops.title: Walk this line; read your trace
stops.action: Walk across the glass-covered basin, alongside and across the black stripe. Compare it with your recorded route.
stops.question: What kind of line does your movement leave?

stops.title: Two lines, three, four, more
stops.action: Keep count and lengths fixed while changing relations: two can cross or be skew; three can close a planar triangle; four can fold a closed outline out of the plane. Then compare six-rod grids and a tetrahedron before adding a twelve-edge cube.
stops.question: What becomes possible when we add a segment, and what can change without adding one?
stops.stage: count-led artifact and book; 29-case geometric study; headset review pending

stops.title: Carry a fixed span
stops.action: Carry and turn the original grabbable line. Compare its fixed length with the independently movable segments in the workshop.
stops.question: What changes when the arrangement no longer shares one plane?

stops.title: Compare viewpoints
stops.action: Walk around the existing perspective arrangements and parallel lines. Compare their views with the rails and drawing in the workshop.
stops.question: What appears joined from here, and separates when you move?
